title: Memory-bounded spectral representation scheduling
counterexample_search_results: Exact checker audits include 55 malformed/stale/home/memory checks and 4774 independent transform/read comparisons. Thirty-two privileged planner variants and a real generic runtime portfolio still miss the fixed 20% target. The officially isolated portfolio achieves 18.069245% core and 9.349567% worst-family reduction in 77.52 execution seconds. No optimal-cost lower bound, passing solution, or impossibility proof is known.
capability_failure: Both agents build valid planners but stop at 17.28% and 17.99% overall savings, below the fixed 20% target. The remaining gap is global reuse-aware transform planning under weighted scratch-memory limits and version invalidation, not plan validity or worst-family failure.
